text:
omar_pm: Hey team — planning the annual roadmap retreat. Need to lock dates & facilitation plan. Main goals: prioritize initiatives for FY27, align launch criteria for Dedicated 2.0, and negotiate scope with Eng. Thoughts on week options? :calendar:

jess_product: +1 week of May 13-17 works for me, avoids most customer Q1 calls. Prefer 2 full days of facilitation + 1 async day.

liz_design: May 13-17 is rough for me (conference). May 20-24 ok.

kai_eng: May 20-24 better on my side too. We have a big infra rollout mid-May.

omar_pm: OK pushing to May 20-24. Can everyone keep Tue/Wed as core in-person facilitation days?

sam_ops: Tue/Wed fine. Need heads up for travel approvals — please set invites early.

mira_research: I'll be remote but can join both days. Suggest we run a customer-evidence slot to validate prioritization hypotheses.

ana_devex: quick note: if folks want remote-friendly retros/affinity mapping, we'll reserve a Miro board and a Zoom room with breakout pre-seeded.

jess_product: Great. Need concrete prework: product leads to submit top 6 initiatives with 1-pager + launch criteria by May 6.

omar_pm: Agreed. I'll make a template. Propose owners for facilitation: jess and liz for product/design tracks, kai for tech constraints, sam for ops/rollout risks. Thoughts?

liz_design: happy to co-facilitate product/design sessions.

kai_eng: can do the tech constraint session but prefer co-fac with an infra PM — @sam_ops?

sam_ops: I can co-facilitate the infra constraints block.

mira_research: I'll take the customer evidence slot and run the 90-min synthesis exercise.

omar_pm: Perfect. Agenda draft below — please flag edits.

```
Day 1 (Tue):
- 09:00 Welcome + objectives (omar)
- 09:30 Customer evidence + synthesis (mira)
- 11:00 Breakouts: initiative pitch decks (mixed pods)
- 12:30 Lunch
- 13:30 Impact vs Effort scoring + voting
- 15:30 Tech constraints + dependencies (kai + sam)
- 16:30 Quick decisions + homework (assign owners)

Day 2 (Wed):
- 09:00 Recap + unresolved items
- 09:30 Roadmap sequencing + capacity planning
- 11:00 Launch criteria deep-dive (product + eng leads)
- 12:30 Lunch
- 13:30 Negotiation sessions (scope/cuts)
- 15:00 Final prioritization & sign-offs
- 16:00 Next steps + comms plan (ana_devex)

Day 3 (Thu - async):
- Written decisions & playbooks posted
- Follow-up 1:1s for blockers
```

jess_product: Looks good. Add an explicit breakout for risk/regression checks for Dedicated 2.0.

liz_design: Also want a short session on constraints for UX experiments (A/Bs) post-launch.

kai_eng: We need timeboxed engineering trade-off decisions — recommend blocking 45 mins in Day 2 before sequencing.

omar_pm: I'll insert a 45-min engineering trade-off block at 10:45 on Day 2.

sam_ops: Travel logistics: please RSVP in calendar by EOD Friday so ops can book. calendar_bot: "Tentative hold created for May 21-22 09:00-17:00, Redwood HQ + remote link. Please accept or decline."

mira_research: Prework checklist request:
- Initiative 1-pager (what, why, success metrics)
- Minimal customer evidence (quotes, tickets, usage metrics)
- Known risks & open questions
- Required cross-team resources

jess_product: I'll push a template doc and a Miro canvas. Will share links by EOD tomorrow.

ana_devex: I'll create the Miro board and seed it with the affinity map and group assignments. Also will add a short facilitation guide for breakout leads (how to run 45-min pitch -> 15-min Q&A).

liz_design: One facilitation ask: please keep breakout groups cross-functional. Past offsites got too product-heavy.

kai_eng: Agreed. Also can someone collect the top 3 open infra tickets that could block releases? I can bring those to the session.

sam_ops: I'll compile release blockers and a deployment runbook summary.

omar_pm: Ownership summary:
- Agenda & template: jess_product (due May 1)
- Miro + facilitation docs: ana_devex (due May 6)
- Customer evidence collate: mira_research (due May 6)
- Infra blockers list: sam_ops + kai_eng (due May 10)
- RSVP + travel: everyone (by Apr 28)

jess_product: small ask — can we include a 30-min external customer panel? I can reach out to 2 customers.
\om ar_pm: (typo)

omar_pm: Love the idea. Jess, grab 2 customers and I'll handle NDAs if needed. Slot 14:00 Day 1?

jess_product: 14:00 Day 1 works for me. I'll ping two CSM contacts.

mira_research: For prioritization voting, suggest we use weighted scoring (impact * confidence) and run the ballot asynchronously after Day 2 to give teams time to resolve dependencies.

liz_design: Weighted scoring + short comment field sounds good. We should define threshold for MVP vs deferred.

omar_pm: Decision: use weighted scoring, set MVP threshold = 60 points, deferred < 40, rest needs follow-up. I'll put the rubric in the template.

kai_eng: One more ask: engineering capacity estimate doc per team (2-3 bullets) due May 6 so sequencing isn't fantasy.

jess_product: Noted. I'll add that to the template.

sam_ops: Ops note: if any team needs a staging cluster for experiments, request by May 10.

ana_devex: Created board and invite — link: https://miro.com/app/board/xyz123 (private to Redwood).

jess_product: Shared template: https://docs.redwood.com/roadmap/retreat-template (edit access for product leads).

omar_pm: Thanks all. Next check-in: quick sync Friday 9am to confirm RSVPs and outstanding prework. Please add items to the Miro "parking lot" if you can't make the Friday sync. :thumbsup:

calendar_bot: "Reminder: Friday 09:00 - Roadmap retreat RSVP check-in. 8 attendees confirmed."

liz_design: I'll be offline Thu morning but RSVP done.

mira_research: All prework items on my list — will upload evidence by May 6.

kai_eng: Will prepare infra blockers and capacity bullets.

sam_ops: Travel requests submitted for May 20-22.

omar_pm: Closing thread — adding a pinned note in the product channel with key links. If anyone has blocking conflicts, DM me. Thanks team :rocket:
